key_reasoning.reason: Three components touched — AgentWorkspaceBrowserPopup.tsx (UI), agentWorkspace.ts store method (Service), api.ts downloadFileStream (shared HTTP utility) — but the store/UI wiring mirrors the existing downloadSelectedFile pattern exactly, and the api.ts change is a single additive, backward-compatible optional callback parameter, not a new abstraction.

Three layers: UI (download-all button + disabled/loading states), Service/Store (downloadAllFiles with re-entrant guard), Infrastructure (downloadFileStream reading response headers). No persistence or schema layer touched.
